resolvedIssues: Initial unit assertions still expected JSON-only Desktop capability; updated to verify both working adapters. The relay was initially blocked by sandbox EPERM and passed outside the sandbox.

Initial Desktop E2E: 16 passed, 5 failed. Consumer comparisons had different container padding/fonts and sampled in-flight transitions; matched integration conditions and polled current computed styles. The icon test now clicks its visible label.
Screenshot review found the phone drawer opening at the library rather than at the selected properties. Added local drawer scrolling and viewport assertions, without timers.

The screenshot refinement changed the Mobile pane preference and hid its material shortcut (3 browser failures in desktop-builder-final). Restored the Mobile preference; all affected Builder/Studio regressions passed in mobile-regression-final.

runtime.notes: Desktop consumer E2E compare these bytes with the packages and compare computed geometry/styles with the Stage.

limitations: Desktop navigation semantics only; no tabs without a panel contract.
Logical groups have no independent runtime control; empty groups have no Canvas geometry.
No dropdown, hamburger or automatic Desktop/Mobile conversion.
Glass refraction requires a separate opaque source and SVG support; CSS/opaque fallback and existing WebGL2 DOM limits apply.
Safari/WebKit, physical devices, Android WebView and manual screen reader audits were not run.
Browser zoom at 200% and arbitrary material colour contrast were not audited.
